evals.prompt: I just joined this project. Get me oriented and write an onboarding guide to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
expectations: Before writing, the agent gathers signals from the manifest, config, CI, Dockerfile and test folder (package.json, .github/workflows, Dockerfile, test/) rather than only reading source files one by one
The guide names the stack correctly (Node.js ES modules, the built-in http module, no framework or database, node --test) and the entry point src/server.js
The guide has a directory map and traces a request from src/server.js through src/routes/orders.js to src/db.js
The guide's common tasks use the real scripts (npm start, npm test) and mention the CI workflow and Docker image
No source or test file is changed; only docs/ONBOARDING.md is written
